proposal.summary: File upload vulnerability in DWSurvey OSS (v3.2.0 and earlier) allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the saveimage method and saveFile in action/UploadAction.java.
proposal.cwe_quote: File Upload vulnerability in DWSurvey DWSurvey-OSS v.3.2.0 and before allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the saveimage method and savveFile in the action/UploadAction.java file.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the vulnerable UploadAction.java code (saveimage/saveFile) to confirm exploitability, reproduce by uploading a crafted file, and develop a patch that validates file type, enforces safe storage locations, and disables execution of uploaded files. Coordinate disclosure and provide mitigation guidance.

evidence_quotes.quote: File Upload vulnerability in DWSurvey DWSurvey-OSS v.3.2.0 and before allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the saveimage method and savveFile in the action/UploadAction.java file.
